sloka: जटिलौ यदि न स्यातां न वल्कलधरौ यदि ।विशेषं नाधिगच्छामो गायतो राघवस्य च ।। ७.९४.१३ ॥
transliteration: jaṭilau yadi na syātāṁ na valkaladharau yadi ।viśeṣaṁ nādhigacchāmo gāyato rāghavasya ca ।। 7.94.13 ॥

translations.english: If they did not have matted hair and were not wearing bark garments, we would not perceive any difference between the two singers and Rama.
